_comment: One proxy per account. Sticky session labels keep the exit IP stable per account.
adapt it to your provider. The real file is gitignored.
Optional `accounts` map pins each email to its own proxy so no account rides another account's exit IP or country. Without it, a proxy is picked at random.
711proxy: the session label must be <= 11 chars. Longer labels do not error, they silently leave the requested region.
